name: Chimil
aliases: the sun at the center of Ixalan's Core
description: The sun lighting hollow Ixalan, whose magic an ancient civilization uses to grow in power.

description_citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first humans, the Komon Winaq, awake inside the Core of Paradise and understand Chimil as their creator.
timeline.quote: they would be called the Komon Winaq , or the Fifth People

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Fifth Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Fomori arrive, end the Age of the Sun and enclose Chimil in a shell, plunging the Core into darkness.
timeline.quote: the Fomori completed their shell around Chimil, and total darkness fell throughout the Core

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Age of the Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chimil shatters the shards, blasting away the Fomori and empowering the Komon into Ixalan's first angels; the Deep Gods return.
timeline.quote: the first angels of Ixalan

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Night War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz announces the end of the Fifth Age and demands sacrifices.
timeline.quote: The end of the Fifth Age is upon us

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz leads the legion out and vows to imprison Chimil and end the Fifth Age.
timeline.quote: I will end the Fifth Age at last, and my children will bring the Sixth Age to the plane.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz reforms the shattered sphere around the sun to imprison Chimil.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz wielded his power to reform a shattered sphere that would soon imprison Chimil.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The casing around the sun shifts apart and light shines through again.
timeline.quote: As the dust cleared, the casing around the sun shifted apart slowly, almost imperceptibly.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The second Sun Empire delegation reaches Oteclan to find Chimil restored while pyres burn.
timeline.quote: The second Sun Empire delegation reached Oteclan a week after the battle, to find Chimil restored to her previous glory even as pyres of the dead burned.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint recalls the Oltec story of colonizers whose vessels caged Chimil.
timeline.quote: Their stories described giants whose great, dark vessels appeared in the sky, blotting out the light of Chimil and then caging her within a metal prison.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz flies to Chimil to snuff it out, but his minions are defeated by the Sun Empire.
timeline.quote: However, they were defeated by the forces of the Sun Empire present in the Core.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Coin Empire's invasion, Chimil was caged and freed only after 320 years of darkness when the Oltec attacked; she destroyed her prison.
timeline.quote: After an invasion by the Coin Empire , she was caged by their invasion ships

citation.text: "Chimil", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the colonizers and making the Komon the first angels of Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the first angels of Ixalan

citation.text: "Chimil", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz returned and tried to reassemble Chimil's imprisoning sphere, briefly plunging the Core into night.
timeline.quote: the bat god attempted to reassemble Chimil's imprisoning sphere, briefly plunging the Core into nighttime.

citation.text: "Chimil", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coin Empire invades Ixalan's Core, turns on the Oltec and cages Chimil in an assembly of ships.
timeline.quote: eventually caging the inner sun Chimil within an assembly of their invasion ships

citation.text: "Coin Empire", section "Invasion of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a 320-year Night War, Chimil destroys its prison.
timeline.quote: This went on for 320 years

citation.text: "Coin Empire", section "Invasion of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Fomori arrive and establish dominion over the Core, completing a shell around Chimil that plunges the Core into darkness.
timeline.quote: the Fomori completed their shell around Chimil, and total darkness fell throughout the Core

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Age of the Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chimil shatters the shards of her cage, blasting away the Fomori and creating the first angels of Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the first angels of Ixalan

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Night War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After 320 years of darkness, the Oltec attack the colonizers and Chimil destroys her prison.
timeline.quote: After 320 years of darkness, the Oltec launched a final attack against the colonizers

citation.text: "Cosmium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cosmium lashes out from Chimil, blasting the colonizers and creating the first angels from the Komon.
timeline.quote: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the colonizers

citation.text: "Cosmium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz turns several Legion of Dusk vampires into demons to help eclipse Chimil.
timeline.quote: several Legion of Dusk vampires were turned into demons by Aclazotz

citation.text: "Demon", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first humans awaken inside the Core of Paradise and understand Chimil as their creator, becoming the Komon Winaq.
timeline.quote: Humans stood to their full height under Chimil and understood her to be their creator.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coin Empire invades the Core, blots out Chimil's light and cages her in a metal prison.
timeline.quote: They blotted out the light of Chimil and then caged her within a metal prison.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "Age of the Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chimil shatters the Fomori prison and cosmium blasts away the Fomori, creating the first angels of Ixalan; the Deep Gods return.
timeline.quote: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the Fomori while innervating the Komon

citation.text: "Oltec", section "Night War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz attacks Chimil while Vito's followers rampage in the Oltec city and kill Inti.
timeline.quote: killed Huatli 's cousin Inti

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Past the caves, Ixalan is found to be a hollow world with a Core lit by Chimil.
timeline.quote: they find that Ixalan is a hollow world with Ixalan's Core in the middle and lit by Chimil , its sun.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An ancient civilization uses Chimil's magic to grow in power.
timeline.quote: An ancient civilization , ancestors of the Sun Empire , uses the magic of Chimil to grow in power.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vito's followers rampage into the Oltec city and kill Inti.
timeline.quote: killed Huatli 's cousin Inti

citation.text: "Vito Quijano de Pasamonte", section "Freeing Aclazotz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
